## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update project documentation to reflect the new per-story PR review pipeline, story-branch invariant, and Strategy E region-split.

## File Changes

- Architecture section: Add pointer for sprint-active marker lifecycle (Phase A creates, Phase I removes, gitignored)
